map.：桥墩承受竖向反力合计 A=4800 kN，采用盆式橡胶支座容许承载力 B=60: The pier carries a total vertical reaction A = 4800 kN, and the pot rubber bearing has an allowable capacity B = 6000 kN. Stress ratio = A/B = 4800/6000 = 0.80; safety factor = B/A = 6000/4800 = 1.25. When A rises to 5200 kN the SF drops to 1.15, still above 1.0 but the margin narrows; if A reaches 9000 kN then SF = 0.67 < 1, meaning the bearing is overloaded and needs a different type or an extra bearing.
map.怎么理解安全系数 B/A？: How Should I Understand the Safety Factor B/A?
map.这里 A 为支座实际承受的竖向反力、B 为支座容许承载力，安全系数=容许/实际，: Here A is the vertical reaction the bearing actually carries and B is its allowable capacity, so the safety factor = allowable / actual and must be >= 1. The larger the ratio the more margin; below 1 means overload, and a larger bearing or a revised load distribution is needed.
